_comment: Native forms of science, geography and astronomy terms and of people, per locale, as each country's universities, schools and space agency write them (operator 2026-10-17). Vehicle, mission, agency and company names are NOT here — they follow the origin rule (src/lib/name-origins.js). Unsure forms were checked against native pages; `sources` records where. Order of locales: ru ja zh-CN ko hi ar sr-Cyrl de fr es it nl pt-BR. `term` (2026-10-31 pilot): technical space terms — binding form per locale, `_match` stems (with inflections and accepted variants) for scripts/i18n-tools/term-drift.mjs, `_en` = the English sense pattern, `_confidence` per locale. Not applied by replace scripts: terms inflect.

sources.hi:planets: NCERT class 6 'सौरमंडल से पृथ्वी' via shaalaa.com / iasexamportal.com: बुध, शुक्र, पृथ्वी, मंगल, बृहस्पति, शनि, अरुण, वरुण, यम (प्लूटो); bharatdiscovery.org/india/सौरमण्डल: अरुण (यूरेनस), वरुण (नेपच्यून)
sources.blast zone (surface close-up ring labels: Not a /glossary `term` (that would add a public glossary page entry in 14 locales). Forms used in hotspot-metadata labels 'LM blast zone' / 'Chang'e 3 blast zone': ru зона воздействия струи; hi प्लूम प्रभाव क्षेत्र (ISRO Hindi Chandrayaan-3 results page says 'इंजन प्लूम'); ko 플룸 영향 영역 and zh 羽流 follow the site's own 플룸 / 羽流 for plume (missions/dimorphos DART, Enceladus); ar منطقة تأثير العادم (site: عمود for plume, 'عادم' engine exhaust standard); ja 噴射域, zh 喷流区 and the Latin-script locales (de Abgasbereich, fr zone de souffle, es zona de chorro, it zona del getto, nl uitblaaszone, pt-BR zona do jato, sr зона издувавања) are the first agents' forms, NOT checked on native pages: no native-language source found in 10 searches. English source: LROC 'blast zone' (Speyerer et al.). Earlier forms ar منطقة اندفاع, hi झोंका क्षेत्र, ko 분사 영역 were coinages and are replaced.
sources.seismometer, retroreflector, ALSEP footp: seismometer matches the site's existing forms in all 13 locales (ar مقياس الزلازل as in missions/mars/insight); retroreflector follows the site (ru ретрорефлектор, ar عاكسات راجعة). Unverified coinages left as written: ko 발자국 길, hi पदचिह्न-मार्ग (footpath), ko 돌출부 / hi उभरा हुआ हिस्सा (lobe), ja 足跡 / zh 足迹 (footprints for footpaths), ru задний кожух (backshell).
sources.features: Wikidata sitelinks = each language Wikipedia title (scripts/i18n-tools/wikidata-labels.mjs → maps/2026-10-17-translation-cleanup/wikidata-features.tsv). ru/ja/zh/ko/ar/sr translate maria and Mars features; de/es/it/nl/pt keep Latin IAU names; fr per frwiki title (Mer de la Tranquillité, but Mare Crisium). zh-CN converted to simplified. hi: no hiwiki articles — meaning translated like ja/zh/ru (शांति सागर); Mars-feature forms without a native article follow the nearest language pattern and are unverified. Every cell whose locale shows "-" in wikidata-features.tsv (no article in that language) is a constructed form, unverified: Mars features in ko/hi/ar/sr-Cyrl, Hadley–Apennine and Fra Mauro in most locales, Margaritifer Sinus and Aeolis Mons (no Wikidata hit), Shioli in zh-CN.
sources.places: Each language Wikipedia title via wikidata-labels.mjs (maps/2026-10-17-translation-cleanup/wikidata-launch-sites.tsv). Launch sites are places: native in every locale where its Wikipedia writes them natively; de/it/nl keep Cape Canaveral. Pad codes (SLC-40, LC-39A) unchanged. Unverified (no article in that language): sr-Cyrl Кејп Канаверал, Ђиуцјуен, Тајјуен, Венчанг, Сичанг, Старбејс, Танегашима; ar/hi Jiuquan..Xichang where "-"; Starbase in ja/ko/hi/ar.
sources.station: ISS: every Wikipedia uses its own language name; abbreviation in text: ru МКС, sr-Cyrl МСС (Међународна свемирска станица), es EEI; zh-CN and ar use the full name; others write ISS. Full name: each Wikipedia title; ru uses МКС in running text (the full name needs adjective declension; Russian prose writes МКС). nl keeps ISS (nlwiki "ISS (ruimtestation)"; Dutch prose: het ISS).
sources.facility: Whole facility names = each language Wikipedia title (wikidata-launch-sites.tsv), lower-cased where they run inside a sentence. Unverified where that language has no article (sr-Cyrl, hi for most, Air Force Station forms).
sources.names: Second batch (2026-10-17): every capitalised name in the English source classified by Wikidata (name-inventory.mjs → maps/2026-10-17-translation-cleanup/wikidata-name-classes.tsv), curated by hand (names-curation.tsv: vehicles, homonyms, adjectives, Latin genitives dropped), forms from each language's Wikipedia title / label (name-forms.mjs → wikidata-name-forms.tsv; zh-CN through Wikidata's simplified converter; sr-Cyrl only where Cyrillic at the source), corrected in name-forms-overrides.tsv, merged by name-glossary-merge.mjs. Entries carry _qid. body: moons of Uranus and Pluto, dwarf planets, asteroids, comets. star: stars, constellations, nebulae, galaxies, clusters — a Bayer or catalogue alias never becomes the common name; Latin-script locales keep a star's proper name where their Wikipedia titles it by Bayer designation. person: _female / _slavic drive Russian and Serbian declension; Latin-script locales change a name only where it is transliterated (Juri Gagarin) — nicknames stay (Wally Schirra). feature (second batch): hand-built in features-2.tsv on the first batch's pattern; cells for languages without an article are unverified.
sources.ISS (2026-10-18): Abbreviation from each Wikipedia intro: it "in sigla SSI", pt "(EEI)", hi "संक्षेप में आईएसएस"; fr/de/nl/ja/ko write ISS; ru МКС, sr МСС, es EEI.

Every other locale keeps the international acronym. CMSA (China Manned Space Agency): zh-CN 中国载人航天工程办公室, the zh.wikipedia title (Q5099768). CAST: zh-CN 中国空间技术研究院 (Q5099557); CASC: zh-CN 中国航天科技集团 (Q2777589) — zh.wikipedia titles.
